meta.parties: Rajaratnam v. The Commissioner of Stamps

rules.statement: The court held that the partnership could not be established without a written agreement, and that only a one-sixth share passed to each son for estate duty purposes.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held , that the partnership could not be established in the absence of a written agreement. Pate v. Pate (18 N. L. R. 289) and Idroos v. Sheriff (27 N. L. R. 231) followed."
